_README: Every entry here is a KNOWN DIVERGENCE between the two schema paths, not a resolved one.
knownDivergences: schema in migrations/ that the inline bootstrap in server/db/connection.ts does not provide and that no self-heal installer reads.
knownMirrorGaps: migrations present ONLY under server/db/migrations/, which server/db/migrate.ts does not read (MIGRATIONS_DIR defaults to ./migrations), so a deploy never applies them.
Removing an entry is how a gap gets closed. Adding one requires a reason. A stale entry FAILS the check.
